projecthero.guide.omnitrix.alien.goop: A Polymorph: a shapeshifting blob of acidic green slime held together by the anti-gravity projector floating over him. Physical blows only half land, falls never hurt, and he can squeeze through one-block gaps; he spits and sprays acid, leaves burning puddles, whips with stretched arms and swallows creatures whole. A big hit can knock his projector off -- then he is a helpless puddle until he flows back over it.
projecthero.omnitrix.info.goop.role: Shapeshifting acid slime: tough to hurt, acid at range, engulfs foes -- but guard the projector.
projecthero.omnitrix.info.goop.passive.1: Polymorph body: physical blows (punches, claws, arrows) deal half damage.
projecthero.omnitrix.info.goop.passive.2: A blob lands soft and fits anywhere: no fall damage, never suffocates in walls.
projecthero.omnitrix.info.goop.passive.3: Squeeze (Shift+X) shrinks him to 0.4x -- through any one-block gap.
The anti-gravity projector: a hit of 8 or more knocks it off. He slumps into a puddle (small, 70% slower, no moves) until he flows back over it; it floats back by itself after 20 s.
Heat dries him out: he takes 1.5x fire damage.
projecthero.omnitrix.goop.acid_glob.desc: A big lobbed glob: up to 12 within 2.5 blocks where it lands, and it leaves a puddle of acid for 8 s (2 every half second to anything in it, slowed).
projecthero.omnitrix.goop.slime_whip.des: His arm stretches out 5 blocks and lashes: 13 to what is in front, pulled toward him.
projecthero.omnitrix.goop.engulf.desc: Swallows the creature in front of him (4.5 blocks; not bosses or anything bigger than a player) and holds it inside for 3 s: 4 every 0.75 s, then spits it out.
projecthero.omnitrix.goop.slime_bounce.d: A springy leap forward and up.
projecthero.omnitrix.goop.squeeze.desc: Squeezes himself small (0.4x: through any one-block gap) and 20% faster for 5 s. Shift+X again, or any other move, pops him back.
projecthero.omnitrix.goop.slime_slam.des: He splashes down round himself: everything within 4 blocks takes 17, is pushed back and slowed for 3 s.
projecthero.omnitrix.goop.acid_spray.des: A spray of acid in a cone (6 blocks): 12, weakened 5 s and slowed 3 s.
projecthero.omnitrix.goop.reform.desc: Pulls himself back together: +6 health and every harmful effect gone. Nothing to mend: no cooldown.
projecthero.omnitrix.goop.glide.desc: Flattens himself into a parachute: 6 s of slow falling.
projecthero.omnitrix.goop.acid_flood.des: ULTIMATE: he floods the ground round himself with acid (6 blocks) for 6 s: 5 every half second to everything in it (60), slowed.
projecthero.omnitrix.goop.goo_cannon.des: A huge glob of slime that bursts where it lands: up to 18 within 3 blocks.
message.projecthero.omnitrix.goop.projec: Your anti-gravity projector is knocked off -- flow back over it!
